questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：We use 'be going to' structure primarily to talk about ________.
questions.explanation: be going to 结构主要用来谈论将来的计划、意图或即将发生的动作。
questions.hint: Think about what the unit title 'Plan for Yourself' suggests.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：In the sentence 'I am going to read more books', 'am' functions as ________.
options: an auxiliary (helping) verb of the be going to structure
a full lexical verb meaning existence
questions.explanation: 在 be going to 结构中，am/is/are 作为助动词，与主语的人称和数保持一致。
questions.hint: Look at the verb 'be' in 'be going to'.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：What ________ you ________ to do this weekend?
questions.explanation: be going to 的一般疑问句及特殊疑问句结构为：be动词 + 主语 + going to + 动词原形。主语是 you，故be动词用are。
questions.hint: Remember the structure: Wh- + be + subject + going to + verb.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：She ________ to take art lessons next term.
questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，be 动词用 is，后接 going to 及动词原形 take。
questions.hint: Check the subject-verb agreement and the full structure 'is going to'.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：Look at the dark clouds! It ________ to rain.
questions.explanation: 根据天空中乌云密布的迹象，判断将要下雨，使用 be going to 结构，主语 It 对应 is。
questions.hint: This is a prediction based on present evidence.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：—Are you going to read more books about IT? —Yes, I ________.
questions.explanation: 由 Are 引导的一般疑问句，其肯定简略回答应用 Yes, I am.
questions.hint: Match the auxiliary verb in the question.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：Which of the following sentences expresses a future plan using 'be going to' correctly?
options: He is going to working hard at maths.
They are going to living in the countryside.
I'm going to exercise every day.
She going to be a lawyer.
questions.explanation: be going to 后面必须接动词原形。A项working错，B项living错，D项缺少is。
questions.hint: Check if the base form of the verb follows 'to'.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：In 'How are you going to do that?', 'how' is used to ask about ________.
questions.explanation: 疑问词 How 在此处用来询问做某事的方式、方法（即如何实现梦想或计划）。
questions.hint: How translates to '如何' or '怎样'.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：What else ________ you going to do to improve your English?
questions.explanation: 主语是 you，因此 be 动词应用 are。
questions.hint: Look at the subject 'you'.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：Negative form of 'He is going to take up photography' is ________.
options: He isn't going to take up photography.
He doesn't go to take up photography.
He is not go to take up photography.
He isn't go to take up photography.
questions.explanation: be going to 的否定句直接在 be 动词后加 not，即 isn't going to。
questions.hint: Put 'not' right after the be verb (is/am/are).

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：According to the text, what is a 'resolution'?
options: A promise that you make to yourself
A strict school rule given by teachers
A story written by a famous writer
An excuse for failing an exam
questions.explanation: 课文明确指出：A resolution is a promise that you make to yourself.
questions.hint: Review the definition in Section B Reading: 'A resolution is a promise...'

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：Why do people usually make New Year's resolutions?
options: To make their life better and improve themselves
To find a job as an engineer
To finish reading classic novels quickly
questions.explanation: 人们制定决心（resolutions）是为了改善生活、实现自我提升。
questions.hint: Think about the goal of self-improvement.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：To make your resolutions work, you need to set ________ goals.
questions.explanation: 根据课文建议，为了让决心起作用，应当设定小目标（mini-goals），避免目标过于困难。
questions.hint: Look for the term used in Section B for small, achievable steps.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：The phrase 'take up' in 'take up a hobby' means ________.
options: to start learning or doing a new hobby/activity
questions.explanation: take up 是一个常用短语，意为“开始学；开始从事（某项爱好或活动）”。
questions.hint: It means beginning a new activity like photography or painting.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：My father's job has ________ building bridges and roads.
questions.explanation: have to do with 意为“与……有关系”。
questions.hint: Check the phrase meaning '与……有关系'.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：Which phrase means '确保；保证' as learned in the unit?
questions.explanation: make sure 意为“确保；保证”。try one's best 意为“尽最大努力”。
questions.hint: Look for the expression that means checking or ensuring something.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：No matter how hard it is, I will ________ my study plan.
questions.explanation: stick to sth 意为“坚持；维持（计划等）”，符合语境。
questions.hint: It means continuing with a plan without giving up.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：What does 'be tired of' mean in Chinese?
questions.explanation: be tired of 是固定短语，意为“对……感到厌倦”。
questions.hint: Tired here means having had enough of something in a negative way.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：Which form of the verb correctly completes 'Keep on ________ stories'?
questions.explanation: keep on doing sth 意为“继续做；反复做”，动词需用动名词形式 -ing。
questions.hint: The preposition 'on' is followed by an -ing form.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：Why did Mr Guo tell the student to 'try your best again'?
options: To encourage the student after failing an exam and build confidence
To give the student extra homework to punish them
To make the student stop learning maths
To ask the student to change their dream job
questions.explanation: 郭老师鼓励学生不要放弃，在考试失败后重新振作并建立自信。
questions.hint: Think about supportive teacher-student interactions.
